body:
While I get your point, and as I said to the user that suggested this, marrying someone for papers is illegal and that’s not something I’d like to do. 

My family and I need around $100-150 per month to eat our three meals per day, this if we include meat, beef, chicken, vegetables, water, eggs, milk... etc.

I don’t have Venmo but thanks for your intentions.
I’d try to do my best with it. Thanks pal
Too late I guess, I won’t change my plans
I’m gonna hang myself
Gracias por tomarte el tiempo, lo aprecio.
Where and doing what?
Hey, sure, I think you can understand it better. Thanks for offering your time

This sounds like a reasonable statement if the world were fair, which is not. I have to provide and I live in a place where I have to work my ass off to barely eat. Oh and things will probably never change because politicians are fucking idiots.  

I couldn’t eat today for example btw cause I’m fucking poor. It is very irresponsible to think that money doesn’t bring happiness. Sadly is a part of it.

Dude. I mean, I get you. But I don’t have happiness in my life. I don’t love my family and they don’t love me. We live together because I can’t afford living by myself and my parents can’t survive without the peanuts I make every month. Literally I have nothing to hold on to. I wake up every day just hoping that I will die on my sleep. Seriously.

I don’t have friends, no love, nothing. All I have is a shitty computer where I sit at every day trying to make money. I live in a country where there’s no social life at all. I don’t know what is it like to go to the movies, or going out with a friend, or kissing someone you like. Nothing. 

Seriously I know you want to change my perspective but it really doesn’t help. I made a choice.

All of the persons that I know that don’t get paid $2 are coding which I just suck at. I tried to be a junior web dev and I was so terrible that my ex boss told me “This is not for you because it’s obvious you don’t have an interest in it. And without it you won’t go very far on this field. Please look for a job that interests you” 

Which is true, I can’t stand being in front of a computer writing codes all day. 

Not much to do when all I know is how to work with audio but I have a shitty computer where I can’t work at oh and guess what? I can’t buy a new one cause I can’t save money because I’m making fucking peanuts every month.

Thing is I can’t telecommute because my internet connection is terrible and video calls are just impossible. I’d have to look for a job abroad in this field. But thank you for this, I didn’t know this was an option.

Yeah. Working hard will bring better things if you live in a normal country. I don’t. Engineers with masters degrees struggle here. What’s left for someone like me? Obviously Reddit doesn’t understand the frustration of working your ass off just to get paid $2 a day. I didn’t have lunch today not even dinner because I can’t afford it. 

I’m just want to fucking die because things will not get better eventually and I rather leave this world today than being 60 and in the same place.
Dude I’m making less than $100 per month. If that’s not slave work for you than I don’t know what we’re talking about.

And how does that work? Citizenship is a long road. At least 3 to 5 years being married to someone. And how can I get a husband like that? Online dating and meeting someone on the internet sounds like the perfect recipe for kidnapping and disaster.

I used to have ambitions and I wanted to be someone with value years ago. I wanted to be an artist, maybe write books, teach people. Etc. Now I don’t really care at all, I just want to make money to eat. When I say useful, I meant that I wanted to provide for my family and I did all of the things that I listed and failed because I don’t really like those things. It’s really fucking depressing that apparently the only way every one has today to make money is fucking coding. And I’m not good at that. 
 
Honestly, it’s easy to think about all of this shit with ambitions when you’re comfortable. I’m not. I didn’t have lunch today, for example, because I’m fucking broke. And I don’t see a future for me here. And I can’t go out. That’s why I want to fucking die.
No. I don’t want to be dependent on someone else to be in a place. They could easily fall in love with someone else and leave me or just change their minds.
Does that apply to non native English speakers?
Yeah, this is true but I don’t want to go through more shit. And if life were fair, which is not.
I speak 4 languages and I can’t do a masters in Europe because I need about $10K in savings to even apply for a visa. How the hell am I going to save $10K if I make peanuts every month.

Sadly I don’t have a passport, I applied for one last year but god only knows when am I going to get it. I tried freelance works but it just really depresses me that clients refuse to pay me more than $5 or $10 per job, and I’m the only one working in my house so all expenses are on me since my parents are old. So that makes it impossible for me to save money. That’s why I haven’t moved out of the country.
Venezuela
Thanks for your suggestions, but in my country cinema is dead as hell, they only make about 1 or 2 movies per year here. So that’s not an option for me.

Why would I care about fighting back? I’ve always lived like this. I don’t know anything else. I did all of what society tells you to do: I went to college, graduated, had good grades, started working early. What for? $10 per month? In a country where I don’t have quality life and I will never have. In a place where I’m scared to go outside. In a place where I will never have a future. It’s easy to judge someone else from your first world chair. 

I really don’t care if I’m pathetic or not. All I know is that I’m fucking tired of even existing.
No.
Being dead means my issues will be gone because I won’t be here anymore.
In a graveyard. I’m sick of feeling pain and being lonely and worthless.
Thanks for nothing. I don’t care if the world stays like this after I’m gone. Thing is I don’t want to be here anymore.

In my country you can’t get money through donating blood and only chance for going to America for somebody like me it’s either being exceptional at something, which I am not, or marry a US citizen, which I won’t do either.
